---
title: "HPC Answers Report: mean zero priors, diffuseness = .25"
author: "Cody Campen"
date: "11/17/2025"
---
We begin by combining the results from each HPC job into one dataset
```{r}
seeds = 1:200
priors = FALSE
diffuseness = .25
conditions = expand.grid(this_seed = seeds,
                         this_prior = priors,
                         this_diffuseness = diffuseness)

file_names = paste0("sim_", conditions$this_seed, "_informative=", conditions$this_prior, "_diffuseness=", conditions$this_diffuseness, ".RData")

all_results = NULL
for(this_file in file_names){
  load(this_file)
  all_results = rbind(all_results, answers) 
}
head(all_results)
```
Now that we have our combined dataset of each job, let's see some simple summary statistics
```{r}
sapply(all_results, mean)
```
